SPY.title: Stock Market Today: S&P 500, Nasdaq Futures Rise As Trump Says Iran War May End 'Within Two Weeks'— Nike, RH, nCino, Beyond Meat In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures rose on Wednesday following positive geopolitical developments, with President Trump stating the Iran conflict could end within two to three weeks. Major indices showed modest gains, though several individual stocks experienced significant moves based on earnings reports. The 10-year Treasury yield stood at 4.27%, with markets pricing in a 99.5% likelihood of unchanged Fed rates in April.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
